sourceDiagnosis.finding: close serially stops mining/RPC, settles checkpoints using live L1, stops native node, reads L1 head/pending/proven, then terminates Anvil and finally commits the dump. Sending SIGTERM to the parent and Anvil together violates this dependency ordering.

developmentShutdownSummary already recursively projects AggregateError/cause into bounded fixed cleanup stages and numeric protocol observations. Reuse it in the private serve helper; raw messages/stacks are unnecessary.

Signal handler resolves stop and owner enters awaited finally. Current cleanup catch stores only error class/code through describe, losing nested developmentStage. A parent-only initial signal is compatible with its design if this Node process is systemd MainPID.

officialReference.summary: control-group initially signals all remaining unit processes; mixed initially targets the main process and retains final cgroup-wide killing. With mixed, main-process exit can trigger killing of remaining children before the stop timeout. Thus actual owner MainPID and awaited shutdown are essential; neither process nor none is an acceptable replacement.

smallestFocusedProbe.scope: One tiny temporary parent plus child, no Anvil, private state, network or application runtime. Use the exact transient-unit launch/wrapper shape and security settings.
procedure: Parent records startup PIDs, child readiness and receipt of SIGTERM. Child records whether a signal arrived before the parent explicitly asked it to stop.
On SIGTERM parent waits a short bounded interval while child must remain alive, then explicitly terminates/awaits child, records cleanup-complete and exits.
Run control-group to demonstrate early child signal, then mixed to demonstrate owner ordering. Use a few-second test stop timeout, keep SendSIGKILL=yes, verify cgroup empty and exact unit result.
Verify systemd MainPID equals the actual owning Node process. If a shell/python launcher is MainPID, use its existing exec form; do not rely on forwarding that exits before cleanup.
Optional same tiny probe with stalled cleanup verifies the configured final cgroup kill; no production timeout enlargement is needed.
smallestFocusedProbe.productionChoice: KillMode=mixed with existing TimeoutStopSec120s and final cgroup kill enabled, only after the focused ordering check. Keep parent alive until every owned close settles; capture existing fixed shutdown summary on any failure.
